stage: Specified after inspecting the already known central windows and before any off-centre target endpoint search
comparison: The original organizer-anchored forecast uses only the 35, 45 and 55 peak folds at each node.
The transport forecast adds the central fold residual of the same target family, held constant over the small slope patch.
central_calibration: The 65, 75 and 85 peak folds at both central section nodes are calibration data for transport, not held-out tests.
validation: The other 16 nodes, three target families each, are the 48 held-out cross-parameter tests. No target endpoints at those nodes enter either forecast.
primary_gate: Predicted midpoint strictly inside the measured fold-to-symmetry-breaking interval
reason: The central retrospective check shows a systematic location error larger than the thinnest core despite the improved organizer. The second model tests whether this residual is locally transportable. It is a calibrated approximation, not a rigorous remainder bound.
failure_policy: Score and retain both models, including every miss and unresolved solve. Do not revise the frozen predictions.
